K1.stone_why: Moderate polygonal faceting on bowls and curves gives the serif a hewn, inscribed feel without losing its classical shape.
K1.carving_why: Facets are applied consistently across lowercase, caps and digits and stay crisp; 1/7, 3/8 and 0/O remain easy to tell apart, though the cuts are less decisive than in the stronger variants.
K1.calm_why: Steady and composed, with enough texture to give presence without any agitation.

K2.stone_why: Strong faceting turns every bowl into chiselled planes, so the display text reads clearly as cut stone.
K2.carving_why: Coherent across the set, but at bold caps the O, C and 0 edges get slightly jagged and stepped, edging toward a rough rather than clean chisel.
K2.calm_why: Still measured, but the rougher faceting adds a little visual noise at large bold sizes.

K3.stone_why: Faceting is subtle and mostly visible only on large curves, so it hints at stone more than it declares it.
K3.carving_why: What carving there is looks clean and consistent, but it is so faint at display size that it barely registers as a design trait.
K3.calm_why: Very calm and even, close to a plain classical serif, with solid presence from the weight.

K4.stone_why: Clearly faceted curves across all letters and figures give a convincing hewn-inscription character.
K4.carving_why: One consistent cutting logic with crisp straight planes and legible digits; only marginally rough on the heaviest bold rounds.
K4.calm_why: Grounded and steady, though the pronounced facets make the bold numbers a touch more forceful than K1.

K5.stone_why: Strong polygonal cuts on bowls and terminals read unmistakably as chiselled stone.
K5.carving_why: Consistent in concept, but the bold rounds (O, 0, C, 6) show slightly irregular, stepped facets that start to look rough rather than precisely cut.
K5.calm_why: Not aggressive, but the heavier faceting adds some restlessness to the bold display lines.

K6.stone_why: A smooth classical serif with no faceting; only its Roman inscriptional proportions faintly suggest stone.
K6.carving_why: No visible carving at any size.
K6.calm_why: Calm, balanced and confident, with clear presence and no agitation.
